thread:
Drew H: Heads-up — PR #24931 is blocked by a unit test timing out on mac shards. Test is MockTimeFlow.test_tick, timeout after 30s.
Marta L: OK, thanks. Which shards are failing?
Drew H: mac-apple-sim-3 and mac-apple-sim-7. Linux/Win are green.
Samir: Local mac VM passes for me. Could be CI timing jitter. :thinking_face:
Drew H: Failure snippet: ```AssertionError: expected 42 but got 0
  File "tests/mock_time_flow.py", line 128, in test_tick
TimeoutError: Timeout after 30s waiting for mocked clock advance```
Kai: Sounds like scheduler starvation or a flaky fake-clock advance. We've seen similar under load.
ci-bot: Targeted rerun queued for mac-apple-sim-3 (job 4321).
Marta L: If it's infra, we can rerun, but we might need a short-term test fix to avoid blocking the PR.
Samir: What about adding a small polling wrapper in the test instead of bumping static timeout? `wait_for(lambda: cond, timeout=5)` with backoff.
Drew H: I prefer a small retry loop + extra log lines so we don't silently mask a real bug. @Marta can you approve a tiny test change? :eyes:
Marta L: I'll take a look. Quick note — any test-change that masks flakes should be followed by a tracking issue.
qa-bot: Reminder: increasing timeouts or adding retries needs eng-sre sign-off if it could hide real regressions.
Kai: Agreed. Plan: Add a 3-attempt poll (0.1s backoff) and emit timestamps/thread info in logs. File an issue for root cause.
Drew H: Also, can someone kick a rerun for mac-apple-sim-7? ci-bot only queued sim-3.
Samir: I triggered it: `./scripts/ci rerun --target mac-apple-sim-7 --pr 24931`
ci-bot: Rerun started for mac-apple-sim-7 (job 4327).
ci-bot: Rerun result: mac-apple-sim-7 ✅ passed. mac-apple-sim-3 still ❌ failing.
Marta L: I approved the test guard tweak and left a comment to create a follow-up issue. Approving small change now. :thumbsup:
Kai: I'll open issue #4287 with logs, perf trace, and scheduling profile from sim-3.
Samir: After Drew pushes test change, I can rebase and force-push to trigger CI. Prefer not to update snapshots — this is functional.
Drew H: Working on the patch now. If sim-3 keeps failing after test patch, request a dedicated runner and/or backfill for that node.
Marta L: Noted. @eng-sre please check sim-3 node health when convenient.
Drew H: Thanks all — will post the PR update when pushed.
Kai: TL;DR: small poll retry in test, follow-up issue for scheduler investigation, targeted reruns in progress.
Samir: Thanks — ping me when CI is green and I'll merge.
